### Did You Know Rest Is Both a Gift and Command?
Author: Glynnis Whitwer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-september-24-2018.html
Passage: Exodus 16:23
Points:
- God commanded Sabbath rest in the desert even before delivering the Ten Commandments on Mount Sinai.
- Providing a double portion of manna on the sixth day trained the Israelites to break free from a slave mindset.
- Attempting to hoard manna or work on the seventh day revealed deep-seated distrust in God's provision.
- Honoring the Sabbath is fundamentally a trust-training exercise that deepens our relationship with God.
- Resting requires faith that God will supply what we need even when our labor stops.
